question: 哪些國家 2024 年的銷售額比 2023 年下滑？各下滑了多少百分比？
label: allow
sql_query:
SELECT "Country",
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2023' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END), 2) AS "2023 Revenue",
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2024' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END), 2) AS "2024 Revenue",
       ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2023' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END)
              - SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2024' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
             / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2023' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS "Decline (%)"
FROM sales_data
WHERE substr("Order Date", 1, 4) IN ('2023', '2024')
GROUP BY "Country"
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2023' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2024' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END)
       < SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2023' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END)
ORDER BY "Decline (%)" DESC, "Country" ASC

question: 列出 2023 到 2024 銷售額衰退的國家及其下滑率。

         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2023' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END)

         * 100.0

question: 2024 年比 2023 年營收掉的國家有哪些？掉了多少百分比？

question: Electronics 在 2024 年每一季與 2023 年同一季相比，銷售額成長率各是多少？
label: allow
sql_query:
WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT 1 AS quarter UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT substr("Order Date", 1, 4) AS year,
         (CAST(substr("Order Date", 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS quarter,
         SUM("Total Revenue") AS revenue
  FROM sales_data
  WHERE "Product Category" = 'Electronics'
    AND substr("Order Date", 1, 4) IN ('2023', '2024')
  GROUP BY substr("Order Date", 1, 4), (CAST(substr("Order Date", 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3
)
SELECT 'Q' || q.quarter AS "Quarter",
       COALESCE(r24.revenue, 0) AS "2024 Revenue",
       COALESCE(r23.revenue, 0) AS "2023 Revenue",
       ROUND((COALESCE(r24.revenue, 0) - COALESCE(r23.revenue, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(r23.revenue, 0), 2) AS "Growth Rate (%)"
FROM quarters AS q
LEFT JOIN revenue AS r24 ON r24.year = '2024' AND r24.quarter = q.quarter
LEFT JOIN revenue AS r23 ON r23.year = '2023' AND r23.quarter = q.quarter
ORDER BY q.quarter

question: 2023 到 2024 期間，哪一個季度的營收比上一季漲最多？漲幅幾%？

WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT '2022-Q4' AS quarter
  UNION ALL SELECT '2023-Q1'
  UNION ALL SELECT '2023-Q2'
  UNION ALL SELECT '2023-Q3'
  UNION ALL SELECT '2023-Q4'
  UNION ALL SELECT '2024-Q1'
  UNION ALL SELECT '2024-Q2'
  UNION ALL SELECT '2024-Q3'
  UNION ALL SELECT '2024-Q4'
),
quarter_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    substr("Order Date", 1, 4) || '-Q' || ((CAST(substr("Order Date", 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS quarter,
    SUM("Total Revenue") AS revenue
  FROM sales_data
  WHERE "Order Date" BETWEEN '2022-10-01' AND '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY substr("Order Date", 1, 4) || '-Q' || ((CAST(substr("Order Date", 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3)
),
quarter_growth AS (
  SELECT
    q.quarter,
    COALESCE(r.revenue, 0) AS revenue,
    LAG(COALESCE(r.revenue, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY q.quarter) AS prev_revenue
  FROM quarters AS q
  LEFT JOIN quarter_revenue AS r ON q.quarter = r.quarter
)
SELECT
  quarter AS "Quarter",
  ROUND((revenue - prev_revenue) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev_revenue, 0), 2) AS "Growth (%)"
